name: clearslip
description: Manifest V3 ad and tracker blocker for Chrome that shows what it blocked
author: Vincent Wesley

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.test:real: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.real.config.ts real-sites.spec.ts
scripts.bench: npm run build && node scripts/bench-fetch.ts --if-missing && playwright test -c playwright.real.config.ts bench.spec.ts && node scripts/bench-report.ts
